## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow the [Gitmoji format](CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-messages)
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] No real recordings, tokens or model files are committed; test media is generated
- [ ] AI usage is disclosed above (or not applicable)
- [ ] I understand and can explain the code I'm submitting
